title: graph: rights-scoped /changes, view test, proj cap
description:
graph: rights-scoped /changes, hidden-edge view test, typed projection capability (batch 8b review, JMAP-ef3q.2/.5/.8/.9).

1. crate-jmap-graph-server/src/memory.rs:646-648 MemoryBackend::get_changes ignores the caller, and Graph/GraphNode/GraphEdge/GraphNodeOp `/changes` use the generic handler (node.rs:215, op.rs handle_graph_node_op_changes). A user without mayRead sees created/updated/destroyed ids of Graphs, nodes, edges and ops they cannot read; gaining/losing mayRead does not surface records as created/destroyed. draft-atwood-jmap-graph-00 L451 (SHOULD evaluate rights "for every method call that reads"; unreadable Graph "indistinguishable from one that does not exist") and graph-edit GraphNodeOp/changes "requires mayRead on the op's Graph". backend.rs:70-72 documents the duty for query_objects/query_changes only. At minimum document the get_changes duty in the GraphBackend rustdoc; scene-server has the same pattern.
2. crate-jmap-graph-server/src/search.rs:161-191 GraphView::new drops edges whose endpoint is outside the view, implementing the graph-search §Visibility (L315) rule that hidden nodes/edges do not affect structural operators, but nothing tests it (tests/search.rs only covers a fully unreadable Graph; MemoryBackend cannot hide single nodes). Add a GraphView unit test: view without node B, edge A->B, assert $edge/$reachable from A is false.
3. draft-atwood-jmap-graph-projection-00 L130-139 defines the capability as {} at session level and {graphId: Id} at account level; crate-jmap-graph-projection-server only re-exports JMAP_GRAPH_PROJECTION_URI and no crate has a typed account-capability struct (graph-types has GraphEditCapability/GraphSearchCapability). Add GraphProjectionCapability to jmap-graph-types.
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
